mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_spec (item_id, spec_name, unit, cost_price, sale_price, current_stock, safety_stock, is_active, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{specName}, #{unit}, #{costPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{currentStock}, #{safetyStock}, #{active}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, item_id, spec_name, unit, cost_price, sale_price, current_stock, safety_stock, is_active, version, created_at, updated_at FROM item_spec WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, item_id, spec_name, unit, cost_price, sale_price, current_stock, safety_stock, is_active, version, created_at, updated_at FROM item_spec WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE item_spec SET spec_name = #{specName}, unit = #{unit}, cost_price = #{costPrice}, sale_price = #{salePrice}, current_stock = #{currentStock}, safety_stock = #{safetyStock}, is_active = #{active}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
